what: Lumentum makes optical and photonic components: the lasers, transceivers and switches that carry data as light. AI data centres have become its main growth driver, alongside telecom networks and industrial lasers.
customers: Cloud and AI data centre operators, network equipment makers, telecom carriers and industrial manufacturers.
money: lasers, photonic chips and optical components
optical transceiver modules and optical circuit switching
moat: Indium phosphide laser manufacturing, which very few companies in the world can do at volume and quality, at the exact point where AI clusters need more bandwidth.
risks: Revenue is concentrated in a handful of very large cloud customers
Optical component pricing falls steadily as volumes rise
A slowdown in AI data centre building would hit it directly
The shares have risen sharply and price in continued rapid growth
opportunities: Revenue grew about 83% in the last financial year
Faster 1.6 terabit modules and optical switching open larger markets inside the data centre
Cash of about $2 billion exceeds its debt
watch: Quarterly revenue guidance and gross margin as new products ramp.
